verdict.rationale: Entrust IDV exposes a documented public API with OAuth-based authentication, endpoints to create applicants and workflow runs, SDK tokens, webhooks with HMAC signature verification, and a full quick-start guide walking through backend API calls — all confirmed by a live llms.txt probe. This is clearly a documented, programmatically drivable API suitable for AI-native/agentic orchestration. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of OpenAPI/Swagger spec, official client libraries per language, or independent third-party corroboration of API usability beyond vendor docs.
